publications.title: Towards Segmenting the Invisible: An End-to-End Registration and Segmentation Framework for Weakly Supervised Tumour Analysis
publications.desc: An end-to-end registration and segmentation framework for weakly supervised liver tumour analysis, using inter-modal image registration (MRI→CT) and cross-modality supervision. The registration-assisted pipeline achieved a Dice score of 0.72 for healthy liver anatomy on the CHAOS dataset, and the paper analyses the limits of cross-modal supervision when target pathology lacks visual features in the target modality.

publications.title: An Automated Tongue Tracker for Quantifying Bulbar Function in ALS
publications.desc: Bulbar symptoms, including difficulty swallowing and speaking, are common in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and other neurological disorders. This work presents an automated, accessible, quantitative method to measure bulbar function in patients using computer vision and convolutional neural networks for tongue tracking.

publications.title: TorchEsegeta: Framework for Interpretability and Explainability of Image-Based Deep Learning Models
publications.desc: Clinicians are often sceptical about applying deep learning in practice due to its black-box nature. TorchEsegeta presents approaches that help interpret and explain the results of deep learning algorithms for 2D/3D image-based models, integrating multiple XAI methods into one pipeline. Budhaditya contributed pipeline and GUI development.

general_questions.question: What is Budhaditya's background?
general_questions.answer: Budhaditya is a Senior AI Engineer with over 7 years of experience. He holds a Master's from OVGU Magdeburg and has worked for major companies like Ericsson, Cognizant, and Volkswagen, and is currently at VisionHealth.

general_questions.question: Tell me about his medical AI experience.
general_questions.answer: Budhaditya has extensive experience in medical AI, specifically at VisionHealth where he leads ML for audio-based healthcare, and at DZNE where he developed lip and tongue tracking pipelines for speech assistance. He also worked on MRI/CT scan blur detection at OVGU.

general_questions.question: What GenAI projects has he built?
general_questions.answer: Budhaditya has built several GenAI projects: RemoteLlama (a local-first Next.js chat UI for remote Ollama models with streaming and file ingestion), AI Repo Analyzer (FastAPI + Gradio app that analyzes GitHub repos with LLM enrichment), CareerCrawler (an AI job-intelligence platform with skill-gap analysis), and JarvisFlow (a gesture-controlled brainstorming app using MediaPipe hand tracking with an OpenAI extension hook). All are on his GitHub: github.com/BudhaTronix.

general_questions.question: What papers has he published?
general_questions.answer: Budhaditya has 3 peer-reviewed publications: 'Towards Segmenting the Invisible' (first author, AIBIO 2025 / Springer), 'An Automated Tongue Tracker for Quantifying Bulbar Function in ALS' (co-first author, Frontiers in Neurology 2022), and 'TorchEsegeta' (co-author, Applied Sciences 2022). See his Google Scholar profile for details.
